_contract: Cumulative cost of the D-series Top-K adoption validation, across every resource and subrun. A rerun does NOT reset it.
_package_id: the C1 execution package, so the deriver charges this to its GPU ENGINEERING allowance -- the book the 2026-10-03 amendment raised and the 2026-10-04 decision draws on.
_status_is_derived_by: the closeout step, from the filed subruns. It is CLOSED when a closeout exists, because that is the only condition under which one is written.
_teardown_reserve: held back so a session that reaches its ceiling can still be torn down and reconciled rather than discovering it cannot afford to stop.
authorizes: nothing by itself; a session still needs the live price, the limit checks and the same-failure gate to pass
